title: Recovering Nonlinear Functions of Latent Variables: A Plausible-Value Neural Network Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.19282v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When factor scores replace true latent scores in nonlinear prediction, measurement error attenuates the recoverable variance of any $k$th-order component of the regression function by $\rho^k$ -- the $k$th power of the score's coefficient of determination -- for any linear score type. This study derives the bound via Hermite polynomial expansion and proposes PV-ANN -- plausible values (posterior draws preserving latent variance) combined with artificial neural networks (learning functional form without prespecification). The bound governs recovery of the latent-scale function, not prediction of the outcome from observed indicators, for which factor scores are already sufficient; the two metrics are therefore predicted to dissociate. translated_title: 恢复潜变量非线性函数：一种合理值神经网络框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19282v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：当因子得分在非线性预测中替代真实潜变量得分时，测量误差会以$\rho^k$——即得分决定系数的$k$次幂——衰减回归函数任何$k$阶分量的可恢复方差，这一现象适用于任何线性得分类型。本研究通过埃尔米特多项式展开推导出该界限，并提出PV-ANN——结合合理值（保留潜变量方差的后验抽取）与人工神经网络（无需预设即可学习函数形式）的方法。该界限控制的是潜尺度函数的恢复，而非从观测指标预测结果，对于后者因子得分已足够；因此预测这两种度量会分离。一项包含18种条件的模拟支持了这两个预测：在非线性低可靠性条件下，PV-ANN缩小了因子得分学习器与理想学习器之间约五分之四的函数形状恢复差距。
tldr: 本文提出PV-ANN框架，结合合理值后验抽样与神经网络，在非线性潜变量预测中有效克服测量误差导致的方差衰减，恢复了约80%的函数形状信息。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the PV-ANN framework, combining plausible-value posterior draws with neural networks, to effectively overcome variance attenuation caused by measurement error in nonlinear latent variable prediction, recovering about 80% of function-shape information.
